description.vi: Website công ty quản lý cho thuê nhà kiểu tạp chí, mẫu đặt tại Mỹ (Columbus, Ohio), có thêm Anh và Tây Ban Nha: nhà đang cho thuê lọc theo loại, số phòng ngủ, giá tối đa, ngày dọn vào, cho nuôi thú cưng, tự báo "Trống ngay"; hẹn xem nhà; gói quản lý theo % tiền thuê; bảng tính phí cả năm và phần chủ nhà giữ lại; định giá thuê miễn phí; người thuê báo sửa chữa theo mức khẩn, khẩn cấp hiện số gọi ngay; diện tích ft² ↔ m² theo nước.
description.en: A magazine-style property management website, set in Columbus, Ohio, with UK and Spanish versions: rentals filtered by type, bedrooms, max rent, move-in date and pets, with "Available now" worked out daily; tour booking; plans priced as a % of rent; a fee calculator showing yearly cost and what the owner keeps; a free rent estimate form; residents report repairs by urgency, with a call button for emergencies; sq ft or m² by country.

intro.en: Find your next home, or let us manage yours. We lease, screen, collect rent and fix things fast for 420 homes across Columbus.
intro.es: Encuentra tu próxima casa o deja que gestionemos la tuya. Alquilamos, evaluamos inquilinos, cobramos rentas y reparamos rápido en 420 viviendas de Columbus.

showingText.en: Pick a home and a time. A leasing agent confirms by text within a few hours, and we can show most homes the same week.
showingText.es: Elige una vivienda y una hora. Un agente te confirma por mensaje en pocas horas; casi todas se pueden visitar la misma semana.

ownersText.en: One fee, no hidden markups on repairs, and a statement on the 10th of every month. Cancel with 30 days notice.
ownersText.es: Una tarifa, sin recargos ocultos en reparaciones y un informe el día 10 de cada mes. Cancela con 30 días de aviso.

residentsText.en: Pay rent, report a repair or ask about renewing your lease. Emergencies are answered 24/7.
residentsText.es: Paga la renta, avisa de una avería o pregunta por la renovación. Urgencias atendidas 24/7.

emergencyNote.en: Water you cannot stop, no heat in freezing weather, sewage backup, no power or a lockout. If you smell gas, leave the home and call 911 or the gas company first.
emergencyNote.es: Agua que no puedes cortar, sin calefacción con heladas, atasco de aguas residuales, sin luz o te quedaste fuera. Si huele a gas, sal de casa y llama primero al 112 o a la compañía de gas.

text.en: We compare your home with what leased nearby and give you a rent range.
text.es: Comparamos tu vivienda con lo alquilado cerca y te damos un rango de renta.

text.en: Cleaning, small repairs and professional photos.
text.es: Limpieza, pequeñas reparaciones y fotos profesionales.

text.en: Listed on the big rental sites, showings 7 days a week.
text.es: Publicada en los grandes portales, visitas 7 días a la semana.

text.en: Income, rental history and background checks, then a lease you approve.
text.es: Ingresos, historial y antecedentes, y un contrato que tú apruebas.

text.en: Monthly deposit and statement, photos after every repair.
text.es: Ingreso e informe mensual, fotos después de cada reparación.

license.en: Licensed Ohio real estate brokerage, license no. 0000000 (sample)
license.es: Agencia inmobiliaria con licencia en Ohio, n.º 0000000 (ejemplo)

text.en: Three houses, three years, zero calls from tenants to my phone. Statements are clear and repairs come with photos.
text.es: Tres casas, tres años y ninguna llamada de inquilinos a mi móvil. Informes claros y reparaciones con fotos.

text.en: Our furnace died on a Sunday night in January. Someone was there in under two hours.
text.es: La caldera se estropeó un domingo por la noche en enero. Vinieron en menos de dos horas.

text.en: Applied online, toured the same afternoon and moved in two weeks later. Easy.
text.es: Solicitamos en línea, visitamos esa misma tarde y nos mudamos dos semanas después. Fácil.

text.en: Their rent estimate was spot on. Leased in 12 days at the top of the range.
text.es: Su valoración acertó de lleno. Alquilada en 12 días en lo alto del rango.

q.en: How much does property management cost?

a.en: Most owners pay 8–12% of the monthly rent, plus a leasing fee when a new tenant moves in. Use the fee calculator above to see your yearly cost and what you keep.
a.es: La mayoría paga entre el 8 y el 12 % de la renta mensual, más una comisión cuando entra un nuevo inquilino. Usa la calculadora para ver el coste anual y lo que te queda.

a.en: We check income, rental history and references, credit and background, using the same written criteria for every applicant.
a.es: Comprobamos ingresos, historial de alquiler y referencias, solvencia y antecedentes, con los mismos criterios escritos para todos.

q.en: What counts as an emergency repair?

a.en: Water you cannot stop, no heat in freezing weather, sewage backup, no power or a lockout. Call the emergency line any time; for everything else, send a request online.
a.es: Agua que no puedes cortar, sin calefacción con heladas, atascos, sin luz o quedarte fuera. Llama a la línea de urgencias a cualquier hora; para lo demás, envía un aviso en línea.

q.en: Can I keep my current tenant?

a.en: Yes. We take over the lease as it is, inspect the home and start collecting rent the next month.
a.es: Sí. Asumimos el contrato tal como está, revisamos la vivienda y empezamos a cobrar la renta el mes siguiente.

a.en: In homes marked "cats", "dogs" or "pets OK", with a pet deposit and a small monthly pet fee. Service and support animals are always welcome.
a.es: En las viviendas marcadas con "gatos", "perros" o "mascotas OK", con fianza y una pequeña cuota mensual. Los animales de asistencia siempre son bienvenidos.
